limitations: The exact correspondence is established for elections induced by finite simple 3-regular bipartite graphs and a fixed rational scoring rule with u(0)=0, u(1)>0, u(2)<2u(1), u(3)<3u(1). No claim of hardness in planar graph families or at fixed committee size; original source counting-hardness theorem and historical priority are not independently audited.
scientific_integrity: Analytic score and matching proof provided. External classical counting-hardness theorem attributed and cited. Exact-rational computational tests are supporting evidence only; independent audit has not occurred.
title: Counting sparse optimal Thiele committees is \(\#\mathrm{P}\)-complete even with known optimum score
